lines.zh: 我贴着地面一小步一小步挪
lines.en: I shift along the ground in little steps
My body is small, only one block
I slip under the grass

lines.zh: 我爬得很慢，尾巴拖在后面
lines.en: I crawl slowly, my tail dragging behind

lines.zh: 我的爪子在泥上留下细印
lines.en: My claws leave fine marks in the mud
I circle a tree root

lines.zh: 我小跑着穿过两棵树之间
lines.en: I scamper between two trees

lines.zh: 我的脚掌贴在土上不敢抬高
lines.en: I keep my paws flat to the soil

lines.zh: 我从一块石头后面绕出来
lines.en: I come out from behind a stone

lines.zh: 我尾巴在空中一甩一甩
lines.en: My tail flicks through the air
I walk along the tree's roots
I crouch in the grass without moving
My two small eyes are turning
I listen to the ground
My short legs are tucked under me
I keep my claws against my chest

lines.zh: 我抬头看着比我高的东西
lines.en: I look up at things taller than me
I lie mute by the roots
I bury my head between my forepaws
My ears lie flat against my back

lines.zh: 我身上还带着蛋壳的碎片
lines.en: I still carry bits of eggshell

lines.zh: 我在等太阳晒暖这块地
lines.en: I wait for the sun to warm this ground

lines.zh: 我在树根下面挖了个浅坑
lines.en: I dug a shallow hollow under the roots
I sharpen my claws on a blade of grass
You are too big for me
I am only this small
You will tread on me
I retreated into the grass
I am watching you, but I make no sound
Do not crouch down

lines.zh: 你的影子把我都盖住了
lines.en: Your shadow covers me entirely

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被高高地看着
lines.en: I dislike being looked at from up high
Crouch down and I will dare come near
I am not much of a fighter
My mouth is only a little thing

lines.zh: 我后面还有好几个同伴
lines.en: Several companions are behind me

lines.zh: 这片森林、平原、草甸都有我们
lines.en: We are in forests, plains and meadows alike
My eyes cannot see very far

lines.zh: 我的样子看起来不厉害
lines.en: I do not look formidable

lines.zh: 你要抓我的话，我跑得很快
lines.en: If you try to catch me, I run fast
I was knocked rolling away
One of my legs will not move
I am too small to take this
I shrink among the grass roots

lines.zh: 我的小尾巴缩进了身下。
lines.en: My little tail tucks under my body.
I toppled onto the ground
I try hard to right myself
I have only a few points of life
I roll into the grass
Is that In-Training feed
I smell that
Do not hold your hand so high
I cannot reach as high as your hand
This is good for two meals
Do not move your hand, I will come
I smell the feed
You are too close, I stop
My little teeth cannot open it
You knocked me onto my back
I rolled once before getting up
To ram you would only knock me over
I back off two short paces
You nearly squashed me flat
I was knocked sliding a block
I had to roll over to stand
I look tiny by your feet

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我滚了出去
lines.en: We collided and I went rolling

lines.zh: 我的小爪子在地上打滑
lines.en: My little claws slip on the ground
I am not big enough yet
I do not follow any of it
I hide behind a blade of grass
I am not even a Rookie yet
All of this is too early
I have not even evolved yet
That must wait until I finish evolving

lines.zh: 我现在的目标只有吃和长
lines.en: My only goals now are eating and growing
I bury my face in the grass

lines.zh: 我摇了摇头，尾巴也摇了摇
lines.en: I shake my head and my tail too
I pick it up in my teeth
This is bigger than my mouth
I hug it with both forepaws
This is a little heavy
I drag it into the grass
I bite twice and cannot get through
I drag it under the grass with my mouth
I can nibble at this slowly
I stuff it into a gap in the roots
Small as I am, I still stare.
I prop my front half up
My hind legs are tensed
There is something over there
I hunker my small body down
Let me see how big it is
This thing is bigger than me

lines.zh: 幼体只剩一两点血，还是咬。
lines.en: One or two health left, and I still bite.
I have started to shake
I will hide for now
I keep watching its feet
I wait for it to go the wrong way
I hide behind the grass roots
I am working out whether I can run
When it moves off, I breathe again
I dare not move at all
I watch and back away at once

lines.zh: 锁定你了，泡泡也会追人。
lines.en: Target locked. Even bubbles can chase you.
I jump up and bite it
I rake with a claw
My claws are still too soft
I jump and bite its ankle

lines.zh: 我的爪尖只划出一道印
lines.en: My claw only leaves a line
I bite and let go at once
This of mine is only a tickle

lines.zh: 我撞在它腿上，自己弹回来
lines.en: I bump its leg and bounce back myself
I bite and run at once
I must pull back before going again
I bite it from the side
I come out of the feed
I am only one block tall
This meadow is good
I am about to start growing
I crawl out of a clutch

lines.zh: 我一次和很多同伴一起出来
lines.en: I come out with many companions at once
Everything around me is taller than I am
First I look for grass to hide in
This forest is very noisy
I run fast and frantic
I have not decided where to go
The fire came near and all of me burned

lines.zh: 我从低处摔下来，翻了两个滚
lines.en: I fell from a low place and rolled twice
The water went over my head at once
The blast blew me clean away
A small thing went right through me

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的身体缩紧
lines.en: That magic tightened my body
I am hungry, and not grown yet

lines.zh: 雷光让整片草都亮起来
lines.en: The flash lit the whole meadow
Nothing remains beneath my paws
